segments.he: רבינו ז"ל אמר מה יש לאיש הישראלי לדאוג כשהוא מונח עם רגליו להדלת (היינו קודם פטירתו) עם זקן ופאות "וואס האט איוד ציא זארגען אז אר ליגטמיט דיא פיסציא דער טהיר מיט "א בארד אין פאות":
segments.en: The nobleman remembered again in the middle of the road, returned a third time, and asked the servants if they had found money. All said no. He took the gentile servants and subjected them to harsh tortures — but did nothing to the innkeeper. The servants said: "Why do you not suspect the innkeeper?" The nobleman answered: "I vouch for the innkeeper — I guarantee he did not take it. For if he had taken it he would have returned it to me immediately, as before." And Hashem helped the innkeeper and he prospered greatly. Later, when Rabbainu became known, the innkeeper traveled to Breslov, told the story, and gave money to our fellowship.
